claims: Only if your annual turnover from delivery work exceeds $75,000 (line 16 also says 'exceeds').
Most part-time delivery riders do not reach the threshold.
whys: The ATO test is GST turnover of $75,000 or more, not more than $75,000. GST turnover also counts all business income, not only delivery work. GST_THRESHOLD is hard-coded at line 10 and not held in lib/constants.
This population claim has no figure and no source.
constants: GST_THRESHOLD at gig-economy-pay-guide-faqs.ts line 10; move it to lib/constants

claims: Setting aside 25-30% of gross income covers income tax, the Medicare levy and GST.
whys: A GST-registered rideshare driver owes 1/11 of fares (about 9.1%) in GST on top of income tax. At middle or higher incomes, 25-30% in total does not cover both. The range is hard-coded with no source.
constants: none (editorial rule of thumb); could derive from TAX_BRACKETS and MEDICARE_LEVY
